user.title: Add Roomba
user.description: How do you want to get the robot's BLID and password? The robot is always controlled locally; only the robot password is stored.

local.title: Get password from the robot
local.description:
1. Place the robot on its Home Base, powered on.
2. Close the iRobot app.
3. Hold the HOME button for ~2 seconds until the robot beeps and the ring lights up.
4. Within 30 seconds, press Submit.

local_failed.title: Could not get the password locally
local_failed.description: The robot did not answer or was not in pairing mode. Some models and firmware versions (e.g. j7) do not support it at all. You can retry or get the password from the iRobot cloud instead.

cloud.title: iRobot account
cloud.description: Used once to read the robot's BLID and password. Your iRobot account email and password are not stored. Accounts created with Google/Apple sign-in have no iRobot password and will not work.

manual.title: Connect to Roomba
manual.description: Close the iRobot app first: the robot accepts only one local connection. Use the robot password (e.g. `:1:1234567890:...`, including the leading colon), not your iRobot account password.

reauth_confirm.title: Robot password rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The robot no longer accepts the stored password, usually after a factory reset. Enter the new robot password (e.g. `:1:1234567890:...`). You can get it by adding the robot again with the local or cloud method in a second setup window.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Roomba
reconfigure.description: Change the robot IP address or password. Close the iRobot app first.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the IP, firewall (TCP 8883) and that the iRobot app and other integrations are closed.
error.invalid_auth: The robot rejected the BLID or password.
error.invalid_cloud_auth: The iRobot account rejected the email or password.
error.cloud_error: Cannot reach the iRobot cloud or it returned an unexpected answer, see the logs.
error.no_robots: No robots found in this iRobot account.

init.title: Rooms
init.description:
Map and room ids come from the robot's Smart Map. Start a room clean once in the iRobot app; the ids are then prefilled here. One room per line: `5 = Kitchen`, zones as `zid:3 = Under the table`. Then assign rooms to Home Assistant areas in the vacuum entity settings and use `vacuum.clean_area`.

{error}

error.pmap_required: Map id is required when rooms are set.
